# Exercise 1

Using the record from last lecture, in Python: extract the fax number, add a `"mobile"` phone number and remove `age`, then write `phone(person, phone_type)` to return the requested number, or `None` if absent.

```{python}
person = {
  "firstName": "John",
  "lastName": "Smith",
  "age": 25,
  "address": {
    "streetAddress": "21 2nd Street",
    "city": "New York",
    "state": "NY",
    "postalCode": 10021
  },
  "phoneNumber": [
    {"type": "home", "number": "212 555-1239"},
    {"type": "fax",  "number": "646 555-4567"}
  ]
}
```

```{python}
person["phoneNumber"][1]["number"]
```

```{python}
person["phoneNumber"].append({"type": "mobile", "number": "917 555-0000"})
del person["age"]
person
```

```{python}
def phone(person, phone_type):
    for entry in person["phoneNumber"]:
        if entry["type"] == phone_type:
            return entry["number"]
    return None

phone(person, "fax")
print(phone(person, "work"))
```


# Exercise 2

Choose two scenarios. For each, suggest a data structure in Python and R. Explain which operations your choice makes efficient, and state any assumptions.

| Scenario                                      | Python                                        | R                                                   |
|-----------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| 100 integers, repeated elementwise arithmetic | NumPy array                                   | integer vector                                      |
| Queue of customer records                     | `collections.deque` (`append()`, `popleft()`) | `list`, tracking the index of the head              |
| Stack of customer records                     | `list` (`append()`, `pop()`)                  | `list` (`x[[length(x) + 1]] = r`, `x[-length(x)]`)  |
| Word counts                                   | `dict` or `collections.Counter`               | `table()`, or an environment for incremental counts |
| Histogram bar heights                         | `list` or NumPy array                         | numeric vector                                      |
| Million words vs 50 stop words                | `set` with `in`                               | `%in%`                                              |
| Last 10 lines of a large file                 | `deque(maxlen=10)`                            | length 10 character vector, `x = c(x[-1], line)`    |
